title: Petition of Algonquin Gas Transmission Company requesting authority from the Department of Public Utilities to take by eminent domain under G.L. c. 79 and c. 164, such rights-of-way, easements or other interests in land, or other property as may be necessary and have not been previously acquired, for the construction, operation, maintenance, alteration, and removal of said natural gas transmission pipeline and appurtenant facilities situated in the Towns of Seekonk, New Bedford and Dartmouth.
